note: RAM guard defaults. Merge order: this file < ~/.claude/team/ram-guard.json < <project>/.claude/team/ram-guard.json. A later file replaces a kind of the same name field by field (min_free_mb, patterns, tools, enabled) and may add new kinds. 'enabled': false at the top level switches the whole guard off; per kind it switches that kind off. A kind needs 'min_free_mb' (a number above 0) and either 'tools' containing Agent/Task, or 'patterns' (regular expressions, case-insensitive, matched against the Bash/PowerShell command; 'tools' then defaults to Bash and PowerShell). The guard blocks a new call when the free physical memory (available memory: free plus cache that can be dropped) is below 'min_free_mb' of the matching kind (the highest one if several match). It never kills anything.
